Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I’ve had an old 3 burner Weber for 20 years, finally relieved it of it’s duties. The new Spirit 2 saw some design changes, like a lower profile, interesting burner, and flavor bar positioning, stainless shelves, etc. Roasting and Grilling on the new unit is a pleasure, temps are very easy to control, I’ve seared ribeye’s, pork chops and salmon already, and slow roasted several chickens, ribs, porchetta. The new controls are very accurate. I cook in a restaurant that I own, although this unit is at our house, and I think the design and performance is perfect for my needs. We live in North Central Vermont and I grill all year, this new unit will be a pleasure to use when the temps go low and I don’t need to check it every 5 minutes.
Results.Title: Love my new Spirit 2

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
